chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, by a chain mentioning it, from Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade the food of a banquet in which the rich are singled out and the poor are left out.

key_terms.يُخَصُّ: To be singled out or favored exclusively

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet forbid regarding banquets for the rich and poor?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), highlighting the Prophet’s prohibition of 'walimah' banquets that exclude the poor in favor of the wealthy. This ruling underscores the Shia emphasis on social justice, where communal hospitality must be inclusive to prevent class distinction and ensure equitable distribution of blessings among all members of the community.
